integrity.evidence: Full branch-completeness proof, exact rational enumerations by two algorithms, and a published Pascal-column integrality theorem. Finite numeric checks are supplementary.

limitations: Only monic quartics with nonnegative integer root shifts are classified; neither general quartic integer-valued polynomials nor higher degrees are addressed. Exhaustive enumeration depends on a proved rational branch bound, with code available for replay. An equivalent unindexed theorem cannot be excluded.
title: Finite recognition and complete classification of binomid quartics with integer root shifts
